La Richesse Silencieuse

Le guide d'investissement de la diaspora africaine

An investing guide for salaried members of the African diaspora. It names the pressure to build back home, shows why many of those emotional investments never pay back, and gives a simple method: save, buy index funds, protect the family, and help relatives within a set limit.

William Foteping · 31 sections · 90,219 words · about 410 minutes
